excluded_from_primary.reason: no tested step converges. dt = 0.05 and 0.025 ms fail ap_amplitude_mV (agreement 0.40) on both the published 1,088-segment mesh and a 1,264-segment d_lambda mesh; 0.0125 ms still fails ap_amplitude_mV (0.60) and 0.00625 ms fails membrane_tau_ms (0.80) against a 0.003125 ms reference. The failing feature MOVES between steps, which is the signature of threshold-adjacent audit points rather than of an under-resolved integration
excluded_from_primary.remediation: not simulated. Halving again would make the reference the production setting; the honest reading is that this model's prior samples include points where a feature sits on a discontinuity, which a finer step cannot fix

moubarak_snc_da.license: ModelDB terms; free for academic use

ortner_snc_da.license: ModelDB terms; free for academic use

excluded_from_primary.reason: no tested time step converges: step_abs_hi.ap_amplitude_mV fails on 1-2 of 7 prior points at dt = 0.025, 0.0125 AND 0.00625 ms, non-monotonically. Separately, its maximum rate of ~7.5 Hz gives <=3 spikes in the frozen 400 ms window, so ISI-derived conditioning features sit at their definitional floor (protocol_coverage='partial')
excluded_from_primary.remediation: not simulated at all; the adapter and its failing convergence audit are retained as the documented record

excluded_from_primary.reason: step_abs_hi.mean_firing_rate_Hz reproduces on only 25-50% of audit points at dt = 0.05 and 0.025 ms, on both the published 9,875-segment mesh and the 4,096-segment d_lambda mesh. A fast-spiking cell at ~145 Hz puts one or two spikes per 400 ms window inside the tolerance, and the step needed to resolve them is finer than 0.0125 ms
excluded_from_primary.remediation: a converged campaign would cost ~4 h per 256 samples at 0.00625 ms on this morphology; not affordable in this release. Adapter, mechanisms, calibration and the failing audit are retained so it can be resumed

not_evaluable.bbp_l5pc: the recorded value is v_init = -80 mV with e_pas = -90 mV; under Ih the steady state is neither, so v_init is an initialisation setting rather than a published measurement of resting potential
not_evaluable.dougalis_vlpag_da: the model is voltage-clamp-constrained; the source reports conductance densities rather than a current-clamp scalar that the frozen COMPASS protocol measures
not_evaluable.mainen_l5pc: the recorded value is e_pas = v_init = -70 mV, an initialisation setting; the source publishes spike-initiation behaviour rather than a resting potential measured under a stated protocol
not_evaluable.miyasho_purkinje: the recorded justification for every bound is qualitative ('el_Leak = -80 mV with the full dendritic channel set', 'Purkinje high-frequency firing'); no published scalar with a matching measurement condition is recorded in this repository
not_evaluable.moubarak_snc_da: the SNc pacemaking rate recorded here (1-10 Hz in vitro) is a species/preparation range, not a value the source publication reports for THIS reconstruction under a stated protocol; comparing a scalar against it would test the range, not the model
not_evaluable.ortner_snc_da: not simulated (fails N3 and has partial protocol coverage); no N2 target is declared for a model that is excluded from the panel
not_evaluable.tomko_ca1: the recorded value is v_init = -65 mV from the distributed BluePyOpt configuration; the optimised active conductances settle the cell 7.5 mV below it, so v_init does not predict rest and is not an N2 target
not_evaluable.tzilivaki_fsbc: the recorded value is e_pas = v_init = -70 mV; the model is not simulated (fails N1 and N3) and its rest is an initialisation setting, not a published measurement
